info.title: Open-Meteo Weather API
info.description: Open-Meteo weather data routed through the AIsa gateway: forecast, historical, air quality, marine, ensemble, seasonal, climate, flood, geocoding and elevation. All endpoints are GET pass-through to Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com); AIsa handles provider access. Flat pricing of $0.00015 per call (150 micros USD), metered per request.

x-aisa-pricing.note: $0.00015 per call (150 micros USD), metered per request. GET pass-through to Open-Meteo; AIsa handles provider auth.

get.description:
Hourly, daily and current weather forecast for any WGS84 coordinate, up to 16 days ahead, from Open-Meteo's blended high-resolution model mix. Select the variables you need with the `hourly`, `daily` and `current` parameters. GET pass-through to `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast`.

Billed $0.00015 per call, metered per request.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: WGS84 latitude of the location. Multiple coordinates can be comma-separated.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: WGS84 longitude of the location (negative for the Americas). Multiple coordinates can be comma-separated.

parameters.name: hourly
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hourly variables to return. Common values: `temperature_2m`, `relative_humidity_2m`, `dew_point_2m`, `apparent_temperature`, `precipitation`, `rain`, `showers`, `snowfall`, `weather_code`, `pressure_msl`, `cloud_cover`, `wind_speed_10m`, `wind_direction_10m`, `wind_gusts_10m`, `shortwave_radiation`, `visibility`.

parameters.name: daily
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of daily aggregation variables to return. Requires `timezone`. Common values: `temperature_2m_max`, `temperature_2m_min`, `temperature_2m_mean`, `precipitation_sum`, `rain_sum`, `snowfall_sum`, `weather_code`, `sunrise`, `sunset`, `sunshine_duration`, `wind_speed_10m_max`, `uv_index_max`.

parameters.name: current
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of current-condition variables to return. Common values: `temperature_2m`, `relative_humidity_2m`, `apparent_temperature`, `is_day`, `precipitation`, `weather_code`, `wind_speed_10m`, `wind_direction_10m`.

parameters.name: minutely_15
parameters.description: Comma-separated 15-minutely variables (Central Europe & North America high-resolution models only).

parameters.name: forecast_days
parameters.description: Number of forecast days to return (0-16). Default 7.

parameters.name: past_days
parameters.description: Number of past days to include (0-92). Default 0.

parameters.name: forecast_hours
parameters.description: Limit the forecast to a given number of hours from now.

parameters.name: past_hours
parameters.description: Include a given number of past hours.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start of the interval, `yyyy-mm-dd` (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of the interval, `yyyy-mm-dd` (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: elevation
parameters.description: Manual elevation (meters) for statistical downscaling. Defaults to a 90m DEM. Use `nan` to disable downscaling.

parameters.name: temperature_unit
parameters.description: Temperature unit. Default `celsius`.

parameters.name: wind_speed_unit
parameters.description: Wind speed unit. Default `kmh`.

parameters.name: precipitation_unit
parameters.description: Precipitation unit. Default `mm`.

parameters.name: timeformat
parameters.description: Time output format. Default `iso8601`.

parameters.name: models
parameters.description: Comma-separated forecast models to use. Default `auto` selects the best model mix per location.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA time zone name (e.g. `Europe/Berlin`) or `auto` to resolve from coordinates. Defaults to `GMT`.

parameters.name: cell_selection
parameters.description: Grid-cell preference for the coordinate. Default `land`.

200.description: Requested weather forecast for the coordinate.

x-aisa-pricing.note: $0.00015 per call (150 micros USD), metered per request. GET pass-through to Open-Meteo; AIsa handles provider auth.

get.description:
Terrain elevation from the Copernicus 90m DEM (2021) for one or more coordinates. Pass comma-separated `latitude`/`longitude` lists to look up up to 100 points in a single request. GET pass-through to `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/elevation`.

Billed $0.00015 per call, metered per request.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: WGS84 latitude, or a comma-separated list of up to 100 latitudes.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: WGS84 longitude, or a comma-separated list of up to 100 longitudes (positions aligned with `latitude`).

200.description: Elevation in meters for each requested coordinate.

x-aisa-pricing.note: $0.00015 per call (150 micros USD), metered per request. GET pass-through to Open-Meteo; AIsa handles provider auth.

get.description:

Billed $0.00015 per call, metered per request.

parameters.description: Location name or postal code. Append `, <country>` or `, <admin1>` to narrow results.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of results (1-100). Default 10.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Two-letter language code for translated names. Default `en`.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter results.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. Default `json`.

get.description:
Probabilistic ensemble weather forecasts. Each requested variable is returned once per ensemble member (e.g. `temperature_2m_member01`, `temperature_2m_member02`, ...), enabling spread and probability analysis. `models` is optional — omit it to get the default best-match global ensemble (a 30-member set). GET pass-through to `https://ensemble-api.open-meteo.com/v1/ensemble`.

Billed $0.00015 per call, metered per request.

parameters.description: WGS84 latitude of the location. Multiple coordinates can be comma-separated.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: WGS84 longitude of the location (negative for the Americas). Multiple coordinates can be comma-separated.

parameters.name: models
parameters.description: Optional; when omitted, defaults to the best-match global ensemble (a 30-member set). Comma-separated ensemble models, e.g. `icon_seamless`, `gfs_seamless`, `ecmwf_ifs025`, `gem_global`. Each model exposes its own member count.

Also `cape`.

Billed $0.00015 per call, metered per request.
